# rwx_group (Data Source)

Looks up an RWX group by its stable ID or exact name. Configure exactly one of `id` or `name`; both attributes return the resolved values. Missing or ambiguous matches fail during planning when the selector is known.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rwx_group" "deployers" {
  name = "Deployers"
}

data "rwx_group" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The stable ID of the group. Configure either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive name of the group. Configure either `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the group.
